REM sleep prefrontal high-frequency oscillation chains mediate distinct cortical – hippocampal reactivation patterns compared to NREM sleep

Granule cells reorient cortical trajectories to separate contexts

Spatiotemporal dynamics of the human cortical functional hierarchy across the lifespan

“Cerebellar-driven cortical dynamics …” has yet another teacher-student model with cortex. All three teacher-student frameworks must be mentioned in a dedicated section within “Inter-system coordination”

Briefly rehash complementarity

Transfer of responsibilities across learning, both between and within optimizers

This is perhaps the most important section for the AGI audience. How the four optimizers talk to each other – through neuromodulatory meta-control, replay-mediated cross-training, and reliability-weighted arbitration – is where the brain’s learning architecture most diverges from current AI systems and where the biggest insights for AGI likely live.

"We conclude that the cortex-basal ganglia loop learns via a novelty-based motor prediction error to determine concrete actions given a desired outcome, and that the cerebellum minimizes the remaining aiming error." 16
